exposure: Hemoglobin trajectories during pregnancy (stable, descending, ascending)
Time spent within clinically recommended hemoglobin ranges (Hb-TITR)
cohort: The study involved 7,653 pregnant women with complete serial hemoglobin measurements from Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital.
finding: Descending hemoglobin trajectories and reduced time spent within recommended hemoglobin ranges during pregnancy were significantly associated with increased risks of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Descending hemoglobin trajectories notably increased the risk of cesarean section.
